_comment: Upgrade vouching, read at raw.githubusercontent.com/<repo>/v<tag>/upgrade.json by servers >= 1.9 before allowing a one-tap MAJOR upgrade. seamless_from: the oldest version this release installs onto with zero manual steps (schema migrates itself, no config changes required). Same-major upgrades never consult this file. 2.0.0 vouches from 1.9.0: only servers >= 1.9 read this file at all, 2.0 migrates its own schema (comfort ledger, digest minute) with one background rollup rebuild, and the one-tap path now writes a pre-upgrade snapshot beside the database first. If a future release DOES carry manual steps, raise seamless_from (or delete this file from that tag) and the classic follow-the-release-notes 409 protects everyone below it.
